data.name: Vixens of Valor
data.detailed_description:
Vixens of Valor is a dark-fantasy TCG of clashing legions and ever-shifting worlds. Draft your deck, lead your Vixens into battle, and hunt the rarest cards in the realm then descend anew when the next season breaks.

⚔️ MASTER THE ART OF WAR — Easy to learn, deep to master.

  • Channel Ember to summon your Vixens and seize the board, marshaled by a Hero who sets the tempo and strategy of your entire deck.

  • Layer abilities, auras, traps, potions, equipment, and environments into cunning combos and tribe tactics your foe won't see coming — until it's too late.

  • Prove yourself against Duelists worldwide, clash with friends, or face an AI that learns and evolves to hunt you down

🃏 OWN EVERY CARD — Complete the master set.

  • Tear open packs and hunt holofoil tiers, flawless conditions, and ultra-rare alternate art on your way to the full master set.

  • The cards are truly yours — trade singles on a living player market, or cash them in for gems.

  • Forge your dream deck and enshrine your hoard in a 3D album.

🔥 A WORLD THAT NEVER STOPS — New season. New war.

  • Every season descends with a new theme, new cards, and new worlds to conquer.

  • Season 1: Descent pits the radiant Holy against the ruinous Demon — and it's only the opening move.

  • Climb a seasonal battle pass, claim daily rewards, and hoard powerful boosts just by playing.

Recommended for — TCG & deck builder fans · collectors who want to truly own (and trade) their cards · players who live for competitive online duels

This game offers optional in-game purchases of virtual currency (gems)

data.short_description: Vixens of Valor is a dark-fantasy trading card game where the cards are truly yours. Spend Ember, command your Vixens under a Hero of your choosing, and out-duel rivals online. Collect, trade, and chase rare foils and alternate art across evolving seasons — beginning with Season 1: Descent.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core — Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 capable, 4 GB VRAM — NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15360 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required for your account, collection, pack opening and the player market.

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 6 GB VRAM — NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15360 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device

content_descriptors.notes:
Vixens of Valor is a dark-fantasy card game with a mature, pin-up inspired art style. All characters depicted are adults.

Card artwork throughout the game features fantasy characters in revealing outfits and suggestive poses.

The game also includes mild stylized fantasy combat between cards. It contains no sexual violence, no content involving minors, and no depictions of self-harm or drug or alcohol abuse.
